facts.subject: Owner's character (brief stats)
facts.statement: My own recomputation from the brief's stats (Def 1, HP 48, Prayer 44, Atk 44, Str 32, Ranged 56, Magic 44) gives base = (1+48+22)/4 = 17.75. Ranged = 0.325 x floor(56 x 1.5) = 0.325 x 84 = 27.3, melee = 0.325 x 76 = 24.7, magic = 0.325 x 66 = 21.45. Combat = floor(17.75 + 27.3) = floor(45.05) = 45. This matches the Director's correction (ledger seq 49).

facts.subject: Level-based monster aggression
facts.value: aggressive if player combat level <= 2 x monster level; vs combat 45 every level-based aggressive monster of level 23+ attacks
facts.statement: Level-based aggressive monsters attack players whose combat level is at most twice their own. At combat 45 (the Director's figure), any such monster of level 23 or higher attacks (2 x 23 = 46 >= 45; 2 x 22 = 44 < 45). Monsters of level 63+ attack every player.

sources.title: Aggressiveness
sources.quote: When aggressiveness is based on combat level, an aggressive monster will attack a player whose combat level is less than or equal to twice the monster's level.

facts.subject: Monster aggression tolerance
facts.value: aggressive monsters become tolerant after 10 minutes in the area; leaving and returning resets it
facts.statement: Aggressive monsters become tolerant after the player spends 10 minutes nearby. Leaving and returning resets this, and so does returning from a random event. Logging out or hopping does not. Most Wilderness monsters are aggressive regardless of level, and some monsters never become tolerant (for example the WAC surface skeletons, F-3034).

sources.title: Aggressiveness
sources.quote: After a player spends 10 minutes in the vicinity of aggressive monsters, the monsters will become [[tolerant]] of the player and become passive. However, if the player leaves the area and then returns, the monsters there become aggressive again.

facts.subject: Grim Tales
facts.statement: Grim Tales (25,000 Agility XP, Agility 59) requires defeating Glod (level 138; starts at 118). The two wiki sources disagree on his max hit: the infobox says 25 and the quest walkthrough says 'as high as 24'. Use 25. Glod also sometimes quakes the ground, which drains Prayer and turns off protection prayers, and he can heal himself.
facts.caveat: Infobox max hit 25 vs walkthrough 24; the conservative 25 is kept in value. The researcher also left out the prayer-disabling quake, which matters for a Protect from Melee plan.

facts.subject: Darkness of Hallowvale
